mn134:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn134:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
mn134:2.1: atha kho candano devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ nigrodhārāmaṃ obhāsetvā yenāyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho candano devaputto āyasmantaṃ lomasakaṅgiyaṃ etadavoca:
mn134:2.2: dhāresi tvaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañcāti.
mn134:2.3: na kho ahaṃ āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
mn134:2.4: tvaṃ panāvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañcāti.
mn134:2.5: ahampi kho bhikkhu, na dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
mn134:2.6: dhāresi pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddekarattiyo gāthāti.
mn134:2.7: na kho ahaṃ āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
mn134:2.10: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattiyo gāthāti.
mn134:2.11: ekamidāhaṃ bhikkhu samayaṃ bhagavā devesu tāvatiṃsesu viharati pāricchattakamūle paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ.
mn134:2.12: tatra bhagavā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsi:
mn134:4.1: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhu, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
mn134:4.2: uggaṇhāhi tvaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
mn134:4.3: pariyāpuṇāhi tvaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
mn134:4.4: dhārehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
mn134:4.5: atthasaṃhito bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddeso ca vibhaṅgo ca ādibrahmacariyakoti.
mn134:5.1: atha kho āyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo tassā rattiyā accayena senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
mn134:5.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthi jetavanaṃ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo, yena bhagavā, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn134:5.3: ‘ekamidāhaṃ bhante, samayaṃ sakkesu viharāmi kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
mn134:5.4: atha kho bhante, aññataro devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ nigrodhārāmaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho bhante, so devaputto maṃ etadavoca:
mn134:5.6: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante taṃ devaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn134:5.7: ‘na kho ahaṃ āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
mn134:5.8: tvaṃ panāvuso dhāresi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañcā’ti.
mn134:5.9: ahampi kho bhikkhu, na dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
mn134:5.10: dhāresi pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddekarattiyo gāthā’ti.
mn134:5.11: na kho ahaṃ āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthāti.
mn134:5.13: dhāremi kho ahaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddekarattiyo gāthāti.
mn134:5.14: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattiyo gāthāti.
mn134:5.15: ekamidāhaṃ bhikkhu, samayaṃ bhagavā devesu tāvatiṃsesu viharati pāricchattakamūle paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ.
mn134:5.16: tatra bhagavā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsi:
mn134:5.21: ‘evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhu, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
mn134:5.22: uggaṇhāhi tvaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca,
mn134:5.23: pariyāpuṇāhi tvaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
mn134:5.24: dhārehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
mn134:5.25: atthasaṃhito bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddeso ca vibhaṅgo ca ādibrahmacariyakoti.
mn134:5.28: sādhu me bhante, bhagavā bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca desetū’ti.
mn134:6.1: jānāsi pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, taṃ devaputta’nti.
mn134:6.2: na kho ahaṃ bhante, jānāmi taṃ devaputtanti.
mn134:6.4: candano bhikkhu, devaputto aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.
mn134:6.5: tena hi bhikkhu, suṇāhi. sādhukaṃ manasi karohi. bhāsissāmīti.
mn134:6.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo bhagavato paccassosi.
mn134:8-13.1: kathañca bhikkhu, atītaṃ anvāgameti: evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti. evaṃvedano ahosiṃ …pe… evaṃ sañño ahosiṃ …pe… evaṃ saṃkhāro ahosiṃ …pe… evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti.
mn134:8-13.3: kathañca bhikkhu, atītaṃ nānvāgameti: evaṃrūpo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti. …pe… evaṃvedano ahosiṃ …pe… evaṃ sañño ahosiṃ …pe… evaṃ saṃkhāro ahosiṃ …pe… evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti.
mn134:8-13.5: kathañca bhikkhu, anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati: evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti. evaṃvedano siyaṃ …pe… evaṃ sañño siyaṃ …pe… evaṃ saṃkhāro siyaṃ …pe… evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti.
mn134:8-13.7: kathañca bhikkhu, anāgataṃ na paṭikaṅkhati. evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti. evaṃvedano siyaṃ …pe… evaṃ sañño siyaṃ …pe… evaṃ saṃkhāro siyaṃ …pe… evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānanti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti.
mn134:8-13.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhu anāgataṃ na paṭikaṅkhati.
mn134:8-13.9: kathañca bhikkhu, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati: idha bhikkhu, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. vedanaṃ …pe… saññaṃ …pe… saṅkhāre …pe… viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
mn134:8-13.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhu, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati.
mn134:8-13.11: kathañca bhikkhu, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati: idha bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto. na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā rūpaṃ, na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. na vedanaṃ …pe… na saññaṃ …pe… na saṅkhāre …pe… na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā viññāṇaṃ, na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
mn134:8-13.12: evaṃ kho bhikkhu, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati.
mn134:14.18: attamano āyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
